title: Welcome to GLASS
body: GLASS turns walls of glass into screens. A [[terminal|GLASS Terminal]] is a camera; a [[projector|GLASS Projector]] in a wall of [[extensions|GLASS Extensions]] shows what it sees, as soon as it gets a redstone signal.
The same glass can also [[cloak|cloak]] what is behind it, so your base disappears, and the hologram kit and the [[holo_cube|Holo Cube]] capture places and project them back.
Use the index on the left, or search. Pressing the look-up key (G) over a GLASS item in your inventory opens its page. Drag a scene to turn it.
